items.title: CVE-2026-119349: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.0.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js App Router applications that pass binary arguments, such as Uint8Array or B
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.0.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js App Router applications that pass binary arguments, such as Uint8Array or Blob values, to functions using the 'use cache' directive can generate identical cache keys for distinct arguments. Requests with different binary arguments can therefore share a cached result, causing cross-user disclosure of cached data or allowing one request to poison results returned to another user. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-119350: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.4.0 until 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js applications served with next start can allow an unauthenticate
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.4.0 until 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js applications served with next start can allow an unauthenticated request to poison a shared fallback shell when cacheComponents is true and partialPrefetching is unset or false. The affected dynamic route must have a prerenderable param declared by generateStaticParams whose requested value was not generated at build time, at least two never-prerenderable params below it, a layout that reads the shallower param inside a Suspense boundary, and a blocking fallback shell. A request-supplied placeholder route param whose path segment equals the percent-encoded bracketed name of its own deeper route param is incorrectly treated as unresolved, while the shallower concrete value is rendered into the shared shell and its HTTP status is persisted. Depending on application behavior, subsequent routes sharing that shell can receive a persistent 404 or attacker-selected substituted param text. Client hydration corrects substituted text, and the issue does not enable markup or script injection or disclose data. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-119351: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.2.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications with Cache Components enabled can reuse an outer 'use cache' e
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.2.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications with Cache Components enabled can reuse an outer 'use cache' entry across root param values when a nested 'use cache' call reads a root param through next/root-params and returns a value containing pending promises. React Flight can deliver the ready portion to the outer function before the inner cache finishes publishing its root-param dependencies. The outer entry can then complete and be persisted under a key that omits the root param, causing the first written value to be served for other root param values and allowing the outer entry to ignore nested cache tag invalidation and lifetimes. The leaked value is not attacker controlled and depends on which invocation writes the entry first. This variant does not require an existing inner cache entry or a slow cache handler and is not covered by the fix for CVE-2026-103004. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-119790: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.3.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications using the same 'use cache' function directly during rendering
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 16.3.0 until 16.4.5, Next.js applications using the same 'use cache' function directly during rendering and through unstable_cache() can disclose cached data across root params when that function reads a root param. During the first fill after a cold process start, cross-request deduplication allows a concurrent unstable_cache() request to join the direct call's in-flight fill and receive its result before the root param mismatch is rejected. unstable_cache() then persists that result under a key that omits root params, causing later requests for other root param values to receive the same entry until revalidation or eviction. Exploitation requires the unstable_cache() request to arrive while the first fill is in flight. Outside this race, nesting 'use cache' inside unstable_cache() raises an unsupported-operation error, and avoiding that nesting prevents the issue. This issue is fixed in version 16.4.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-119346: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, Next.js applications that use NextResponse to set cookies on Edge runti
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, Next.js applications that use NextResponse to set cookies on Edge runtime routes expose the internal x-middleware-set-cookie header in the public response. This affects App Router route handlers and Pages Router Edge API routes. The header duplicates each cookie value and its attributes, so JavaScript already running on the same origin can read values that the Set-Cookie header marks HttpOnly, including sensitive session tokens set on an affected response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

items.title: CVE-2026-119347: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, the /_next/image optimizer in self-hosted Next.js deployments can proce
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. From 15.0.0 until 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, the /_next/image optimizer in self-hosted Next.js deployments can process attacker-supplied SVG content even when dangerouslyAllowSVG is false, which is the default. The SVG reaches a parser that the application intended to keep disabled, increasing exposure to denial of service and vulnerabilities in SVG decoding. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

items.title: CVE-2026-119348: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. Prior to 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js App Router route handlers and the fetch cache that return a
items.summary: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. Prior to 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js App Router route handlers and the fetch cache that return a fetched upstream response unchanged can emit a response whose declared framing does not match the body actually sent. When the application is behind an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that permits pipelined response queueing, a crafted upstream response can desynchronize responses between clients. The resulting desynchronization can inject a response into another client's queue or disclose another client's response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

items.title: CVE-2026-101327: A maliciously crafted DLL placed in a predictable, attacker-writable temporary directory used by the Autodesk Installer can lead to privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM due
items.summary: A maliciously crafted DLL placed in a predictable, attacker-writable temporary directory used by the Autodesk Installer can lead to privilege escalation to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM due to insufficient validation of loaded libraries. An attacker with local and low-privilege access could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM.

items.title: CVE-2026-129301: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.3, write_attachme
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.3, write_attachments() calls _safe_attachment_filename() and write_sample() without isolating failures for individual attacker-controlled MIME parts. An RFC 2231 filename containing a NUL, a basename exceeding NAME_MAX, or an undecodable base64 payload can raise ValueError, OSError, or binascii.Error and abort the entire save loop. Later attachments remain unwritten; when a caller catches only MailParserError, the failure is not surfaced through the expected library-exception path. If a downstream scanner or sandbox reads only the extraction directory, a payload after the crafted part can be missed even though it remains in the delivered message, and the aborted batch also causes availability loss. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-129306: libspdm is a sample implementation that follows the DMTF SPDM specifications. Prior to 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2, libspdm_x509_verify_cert_chain() in os_stub/cryptlib_openssl/pk/x509.c a
items.summary: libspdm is a sample implementation that follows the DMTF SPDM specifications. Prior to 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2, libspdm_x509_verify_cert_chain() in os_stub/cryptlib_openssl/pk/x509.c and os_stub/cryptlib_mbedtls/pk/x509.c validates certificate signatures one link at a time instead of validating the complete X.509 path. In deployments using a pinned root with a constrained multi-tier PKI, an attacker holding a valid issuer credential below a constrained CA can present a subordinate certificate that exceeds pathLenConstraint or nameConstraints and may be accepted for SPDM identity validation. Exploitation requires the application to use libspdm's backend validation without an additional certificate-chain validation mechanism, the pinned root cannot be substituted, and the deployment's measurement policy must allow identity impersonation alone to satisfy its acceptance requirements. The mbedTLS backend remains unable to enforce nameConstraints because upstream mbedTLS does not implement that check. The full-chain validation changes are released in versions 3.8.3 and 4.0.0-rc2.

items.title: CVE-2026-129295: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.2.0 until 4.6.1, attacker-contr
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 4.2.0 until 4.6.1, attacker-controlled email headers can cause polynomial regular-expression backtracking during ordinary parse_from_string(), parse_from_bytes(), or parse_from_file() calls. In src/mailparser/utils.py, get_addresses() invokes the _ADDR_FALLBACK_RE fallback when strict address parsing yields no usable address, and overlapping quantifiers rescan padded address headers quadratically or cubically. In src/mailparser/const.py, parse_received() applies _CLAUSE_SPLITTER to uncollapsed whitespace in a Received header, causing quadratic backtracking when a whitespace run is not followed by a clause keyword. A small, well-formed message can keep mail gateway, ticketing, quarantine, or archival parsing workers busy for extended periods. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-129296: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.8.0 until 4.6.0, the write_atta
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.8.0 until 4.6.0, the write_attachments() and write_sample() APIs use attacker-controlled attachment filenames without sufficient sanitization and path containment validation. Directory traversal sequences and absolute filesystem paths can cause an attachment to be written outside the intended output directory. An attacker can overwrite files accessible to the parsing process when an application extracts attachments from a crafted message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129297: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, get_server_ipaddress()
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, get_server_ipaddress() can select an attacker-controlled address from attacker-controlled Received headers. The minimum mechanism needed to distinguish this spoofing issue, derived from the advisory's remediation analysis and verified fix evidence, is appearance-based candidate selection that can treat bracketed IPv4 or IPv6 addresses or HELO markers in sender-written text as MTA-recorded addresses and can continue past a trusted hop that names no address. Applications that rely on the returned value can attribute a message to an attacker-selected sender IP address. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-129299: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, multiple message-proce
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. Prior to 4.6.2, multiple message-processing behaviors can raise exceptions or silently lose content. Headers colliding with methods such as Parse, Message, and Write_Attachments can place bound method objects into parsed output and raise TypeError when a caller requests JSON serialization such as mail_json. When byte input is parsed through parse_from_bytes(), an 8-bit header value returned as email.header.Header can likewise raise TypeError when an X_raw accessor passes the value to json.dumps; both exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy. Separately, rewritten names such as Subject_json and X_Spam_Flag can be substituted or disappear from mail, headers, and JSON output while has_defects remains false, and a headerless message can be treated as falsy before parser state is initialized, causing body and attachment properties to return empty values without an error signal. These behaviors can abort message processing or hide malicious indicators from downstream scanners. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-129300: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.7.0 until 4.6.3, receiveds_form
items.summary: mail-parser is a tool that parses emails by enhancing the Python standard library and extracting message details into a comprehensive object. From 3.7.0 until 4.6.3, receiveds_format() in src/mailparser/utils.py catches only TypeError and ValueError while converting the trailing date of an attacker-controlled Received header. An out-of-range year can cause calendar.timegm() to raise OverflowError, and a sufficiently large timezone offset can cause datetime.fromtimestamp() to raise OSError. These exceptions are outside the MailParserError hierarchy, so one crafted header can abort the entire message parse through every parse_from_* entry point and may drop a queued batch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-97894: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a
items.summary: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

items.title: CVE-2026-97999: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Fir
items.summary: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

items.title: CVE-2026-98100: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was re
items.summary: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.

items.title: CVE-2026-97892: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature
items.summary: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

items.title: CVE-2026-91114: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, PermissionCheckboxSetField accepts permission codes that the field did not offer and s
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, PermissionCheckboxSetField accepts permission codes that the field did not offer and stores them without an allowlist, then renders permission codes without escaping them. A user with access to the Security section can save attacker-controlled content as a permission code, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of another user who views the field. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-91115: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injecto
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injector without validating that it names an allowed writer implementation. A crafted dev task URL can therefore instantiate arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and execute code on the server. An administrator can be induced to run the task by following a link because the nested task did not require confirmation, and a site in dev mode exposes the path without authentication. CMS 5 is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-87932: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current v
items.summary: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-88987: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove script-capable XHTML and XML data URIs from stored
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove script-capable XHTML and XML data URIs from stored CMS content. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-88988: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove SVG data URIs from stored CMS content even though S
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not remove SVG data URIs from stored CMS content even though SVG documents can execute script. A CMS author can save such content, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views it. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-88989: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form can send a direct save
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit records through a GridField detail form can send a direct save request that creates a new record even when the user does not have permission to create that record type. The server-side save path checks edit access but does not enforce the required create permission before persistence. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-91110: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not normalize certain control bytes that browsers ignore when
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, the HTML sanitiser does not normalize certain control bytes that browsers ignore when parsing URLs. A CMS author can place those bytes before a javascript: URL in stored content so the sanitiser misses the dangerous scheme, and JavaScript executes in the browser of another user who views the content. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-91112: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a user with CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin but without ADMIN can edit or reparent a group th
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a user with CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin but without ADMIN can edit or reparent a group that grants ADMIN-equivalent permissions through an assigned role or a parent group, thereby escalating to full administrative privileges. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-91113: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form can submit a user-con
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. Prior to 6.2.13, a CMS user who can edit a record through a GridField detail form can submit a user-controlled ClassName value to change the record into an unrelated class without the create and edit permission checks required for that target class. This permits an unauthorized record type change outside the GridField's intended model hierarchy. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.

items.title: CVE-2026-84234: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mas
items.summary: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

items.title: CVE-2026-84443: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document
items.summary: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.

items.title: CVE-2026-86046: termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted
items.summary: termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted manifest.json files.*.source value as an extraction destination, and extract_archive calls tarfile.extract on archive members without enforcing a destination boundary. A victim who restores a malicious or tampered backup from local, shared, GitHub, or Google Drive storage can have files written anywhere the Termux user can write, including shell startup files or executable scripts that can lead to code execution when later used. The restore path also accepts unsafe backup_name values for temporary paths, and archive members are not constrained to the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-64890: : Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls Open Blue Companion Android App on Android allows : Retrieve Embedded Secrets from Software. This is
items.summary: : Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls Open Blue Companion Android App on Android allows : Retrieve Embedded Secrets from Software. This issue affects Open Blue Companion Android App: before R2.22.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-18563: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converte
items.summary: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

items.title: CVE-2026-18564: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are mean
items.summary: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.

items.title: CVE-2026-18565: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The
items.summary: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

items.title: CVE-2026-18566: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and
items.summary: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

items.title: CVE-2026-129235: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the download_file tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go accepts caller-controlled path and dest
items.summary: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the download_file tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go accepts caller-controlled path and dest values, fetches a selected Kubeshark Hub API response, and writes the returned bytes through os.Create(dest) in callDownloadFile without confining the destination. An attacker who influences arguments through an AI agent driving kubeshark mcp can write Hub-supplied bytes to any path writable by the local MCP user and can read captured network traffic from default auth-disabled Hub deployments. The tool is registered without --allow-destructive; reliable code execution is not demonstrated because the bytes are constrained to Hub API responses. Hub-side default authentication remains outside this remediation, so captured traffic can remain readable in default auth-disabled Hub deployments after the local destination-write fix. The destination-write issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129236: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the start_kubeshark MCP tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go uses callStartKubeshark to append
items.summary: Kubeshark is an eBPF-powered network observability tool for Kubernetes. From 53.1.0 until 53.4.0, the start_kubeshark MCP tool in cmd/mcpRunner.go uses callStartKubeshark to append caller-controlled pod_regex as a bare positional argument to kubeshark tap without a -- end-of-options separator, allowing a value beginning with --set to be parsed as a Helm value override. An attacker who influences tool arguments against kubeshark mcp --allow-destructive can redirect the privileged worker, Hub, and front images through tap.docker.registry and tap.docker.tag to an attacker-controlled registry. Because the deployed worker DaemonSet runs privileged with host networking and host filesystem access, a malicious image can obtain node and cluster-admin access when the host already has permission to deploy it. This issue is fixed in version 53.4.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-129237: qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.41, the unpackTar extraction logic in app/utils/tar.go validates cleaned archi
items.summary: qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.41, the unpackTar extraction logic in app/utils/tar.go validates cleaned archive entry paths with strings.HasPrefix(targetPath, destdirClean) without enforcing a path-separator boundary. When UseContext enables the Docker Compose build context path in app/configuration/bundle_docker_compose.go, a less-privileged archive supplier with delegated configuration and/or file-manager access can provide a sibling-prefix traversal entry that passes the check, causing utils.UnpackTar to create directories and regular files outside the intended context extraction directory with qbee-agent process privileges, despite the supplier lacking authority to write those sibling files. In deployments where only full device or fleet administrators can provide Docker Compose context archives, this behavior is hardening rather than a crossed security boundary. The demonstrated impact is limited to nearby cache or project paths sharing the destination prefix, may affect integrity or availability of qbee-agent-managed Docker Compose state, and does not establish arbitrary absolute-path writes or direct code

items.title: CVE-2026-129239: Directus is a real-time API and App dashboard for managing SQL database content. Prior to 12.3.1, Directus allows an authenticated non-admin with update permission on directus_shar
items.summary: Directus is a real-time API and App dashboard for managing SQL database content. Prior to 12.3.1, Directus allows an authenticated non-admin with update permission on directus_shares to modify user_created, role, item, and collection on an existing owned share because authorization checks the pre-update row and does not revalidate the merged row. The update path does not force user_created to the acting user or rerun share access checks when item or collection changes. Setting user_created and role to administrator identifiers causes guest share authentication to derive administrator accountability from both fields, exposing data reachable from the shared item beyond the owner and share role permissions. The issue requires update permission on directus_shares, an item the account can share, and knowledge of administrator user and role identifiers, and it does not issue an administrator token or provide write or availability impact. This issue is fixed in version 12.3.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-113630: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows
items.summary: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.

items.title: CVE-2026-113631: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver cont
items.summary: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows an authenticated view-only user to export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content the viewer never displayed such as custom XML, custom document properties and field instruction text, even when download and form-filling are disabled. The attacker reconnects with a valid Session JWT while substituting an attacker-controlled callback URL, which the Session JWT does not bind, then invokes sendForm over RPC, causing DocumentServer to send the reconstructed DOCX to that URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-108169: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or an
items.summary: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

items.title: CVE-2026-101929: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is load
items.summary: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

items.title: CVE-2026-101930: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to
items.summary: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.

items.title: CVE-2026-101933: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is load
items.summary: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

items.title: CVE-2026-104007: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes
items.summary: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

items.title: CVE-2026-104692: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL st
items.summary: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

items.title: CVE-2026-104920: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Openin
items.summary: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

items.title: CVE-2026-104933: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a vide
items.summary: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

items.title: CVE-2026-106535: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a craf
items.summary: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.

items.title: CVE-2026-100101: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a scr
items.summary: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.

items.title: CVE-2026-101351: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and c
items.summary: LibreOffice can import PICT images, which may be embedded in documents. Parts of a crafted image could be left unwritten, so leftover memory became part of the imported image and could be saved with the document. In fixed versions the pixels of a new image start out cleared, so any part the image data does not fill is blank.

items.title: CVE-2026-101352: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these c
items.summary: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

items.title: CVE-2026-101353: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted docume
items.summary: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

items.title: CVE-2026-101892: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control nam
items.summary: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

items.summary: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to inject unsanitized HTML into Markdown cells. items.summary: Rowy through 3.0.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in default Firebase Storage rules that grants any user holding a role read and write access to the entire bucket. items.summary: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrator access by forging JWTs with the hardcoded 'nodepress-secret' fallback key. items.summary: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade throttling by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header, because trustProxy is enabled. items.summary: NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in linesToEmailContent() that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup into notification emails because comment content is not escaped. items.summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the updateSystem GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated administrators to execute shell commands via the package version string. items.summary: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the getIsPathValid function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access sibling paths sharing a content directory name prefix. items.summary: Contentlayer @contentlayer/core through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JavaScript by embedding single quotes in content file names. items.summary: Contentlayer @contentlayer/source-files through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers who control content files to execute JavaScript by abusing gray-matter's still-enabled JavaScript engine in parseMarkdown(). items.summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register accounts via the createUser mutation on /prime/graphql. items.summary: OfficeCLI 1.0.56 through 1.0.161 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the officecli watch preview that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped numbering w:color values. Attackers can craft a DOCX whose color closes the style element, then abuse the unauthenticated /api/batch endpoint to read local files and modify the watched document.

items.title: CVE-2026-129877: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve server secrets through the /api/v1/config/de
items.summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve server secrets through the /api/v1/config/defaults endpoint. Attackers can send a GET request to obtain the operator's LLM provider API keys and GitHub or GitLab tokens, then abuse those services and accessible repositories.

items.title: CVE-2026-129878: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform
items.summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform SSRF. Attackers can create a project whose name contains a link attachment element and download the task PDF report to retrieve local files or internal network responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129879: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attack
items.summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-129869: SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in WafEngine.ServeHTTP that skips bodies with chunked encoding or lengths of 2048 byte
items.summary: SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in WafEngine.ServeHTTP that skips bodies with chunked encoding or lengths of 2048 bytes or more. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send SQL injection, XSS, command injection, traversal or upload payloads chunked or padded, which reach the protected backend uninspected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129870: Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitti
items.summary: Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitting crafted media values. Attackers can send dot-dot-slash sequences in the avatar or media content to POST /v1/user/avatar or POST /v1/post/comment, deleting server-writable files including configuration and data.

items.title: CVE-2026-129871: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GE
items.summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GET /v1/post endpoint. Attackers can download the paid file directly from the unauthenticated LocalOSS /oss static route, whose signed URL expired parameter is never checked.

items.title: CVE-2026-129872: REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/
items.summary: REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/tasks/list. Attackers can use priority-* plans and the returned task count as a boolean oracle to recover a task creator's SHA-256 password hash and log in as that user, including the administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-129873: REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to obtain a SYSTEM_USER token by requesting /commons/file-p
items.summary: REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to obtain a SYSTEM_USER token by requesting /commons/file-preview with an arbitrary src value. Attackers can read the leaked _csrfToken from the redirect Location header and send it as X-AuthToken to access the admin center and administrative APIs.

items.title: CVE-2026-129863: GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to edit and merge other users' pull requests because the PATCH pulls and
items.summary: GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to edit and merge other users' pull requests because the PATCH pulls and PUT pulls merge REST API endpoints only check read access. Attackers can close, reopen, retitle, retarget, or merge pull requests into the base branch without write permission on public repositories or as private-repository guest collaborators.

items.title: CVE-2026-129864: Frappe CRM before 1.84.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_deal_contacts method that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read contacts of deals the
items.summary: Frappe CRM before 1.84.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_deal_contacts method that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read contacts of deals they cannot access. Attackers can supply or iterate CRM Deal names to obtain linked contacts' full names, email addresses, and mobile numbers, bypassing row-level permission rules.

items.title: CVE-2026-129865: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in DataSourceController.testConnect that allows any authenticated user to open arbitrary JDBC connections by supp
items.summary: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in DataSourceController.testConnect that allows any authenticated user to open arbitrary JDBC connections by supplying caller-controlled connection settings. Attackers can probe internal hosts and ports via returned driver errors, or supply a MySQL JDBC URL enabling local-infile against a malicious server to read files from the Dinky host.

items.title: CVE-2026-129866: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ClusterConfigurationController that allows authenticated users without cluster configuration permissions to li
items.summary: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ClusterConfigurationController that allows authenticated users without cluster configuration permissions to list Flink cluster configurations. Attackers can query the /api/clusterConfiguration/list and listAll endpoints to retrieve full configJson deployment settings for every cluster in their tenant.

items.title: CVE-2026-129867: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by abusing #topic link wrapping in prepar
items.summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by abusing #topic link wrapping in preparePost and parsePostTag. Attackers can publish posts or comments with a crafted topic containing a lone '<' and event handler to steal the PAOPAO_TOKEN JWT from localStorage and take over viewer accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-129868: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 fails to validate the attachment_price field when creating posts, allowing authenticated users to set negative prices on charge attachments.
items.summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 fails to validate the attachment_price field when creating posts, allowing authenticated users to set negative prices on charge attachments. Attackers with two ordinary accounts can download the attachment via GET /v1/attachment, where the negative price increases the buyer's wallet balance, minting funds to purchase other users' paid attachments.

items.title: CVE-2026-129857: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a heap buffer overflow in ReadBinaryData() in jxrgluelib/JXRMeta.c caused by integer overflow of the
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a heap buffer overflow in ReadBinaryData() in jxrgluelib/JXRMeta.c caused by integer overflow of the metadata count. Attackers can supply a JPEG XR file with a count of 0xFFFFFFFE or 0xFFFFFFFF, wrapping PKAlloc(uCount + 2) to an undersized buffer that the following file read overflows, corrupting heap memory in decoding applications.

items.title: CVE-2026-129858: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.6 contain a stack buffer over-read vulnerability in ReadWMIHeader() in image/decode/strdec.c due to an untermin
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.6 contain a stack buffer over-read vulnerability in ReadWMIHeader() in image/decode/strdec.c due to an unterminated signature buffer. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file whose 8 signature bytes contain no zero byte, causing strstr to read past the stack buffer and potentially crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-129859: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in ImageStrDecDecode() in image/decode/strdec.c. Attackers c
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in ImageStrDecDecode() in image/decode/strdec.c. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file declaring a colour format with no channels, leaving p1MBbuffer[0] NULL and crashing the decoder via memset.

items.title: CVE-2026-129860: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.7 contain a reachable assertion vulnerability in ParsePFDEntry() that allows attackers to abort applications vi
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.7 contain a reachable assertion vulnerability in ParsePFDEntry() that allows attackers to abort applications via an invalid orientation tag. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range WMP_tagTransformation value to crash applications using default assertion-enabled builds, or store an unchecked orientation value otherwise.

items.title: CVE-2026-129861: @tinacms/graphql 2.2.2 through 4.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the content root by following pre-existing dangl
items.summary: @tinacms/graphql 2.2.2 through 4.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the content root by following pre-existing dangling symlinks. Attackers can create documents through the GraphQL API targeting a dangling symlink, bypassing assertWithinBase checks, to write controlled content such as authorized_keys to server-writable locations.

items.title: CVE-2026-129862: Koillection before 1.8.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view objects nested under private parents through the shared sear
items.summary: Koillection before 1.8.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view objects nested under private parents through the shared search autocomplete route. Attackers can query GET /user/{username}/search/autocomplete/{term}, whose native SQL filters on visibility instead of final_visibility, to obtain names, ids and counts of hidden collections, items, albums and wishlists.

items.title: CVE-2026-129851: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle gRPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the i
items.summary: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the VolumeServer.FetchAndWriteNeedle gRPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the incomplete CVE-2026-73080 fix. Attackers can supply crafted replicas[].url entries or an azure_endpoint to make the volume server send requests with controlled tokens and bodies to internal services and metadata addresses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129852: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to probe local files by supplying a filesystem path in gcs_google_appli
items.summary: SeaweedFS before 4.42 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to probe local files by supplying a filesystem path in gcs_google_application_credentials. Attackers can send crafted gRPC FetchAndWriteNeedle requests and use differing error messages to learn file existence, readability, and partial content shape on the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-129853: LimeSurvey before 6.17.16+260814 and 7.x before 7.0.10+260813 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the public statistics page via POST parameter names. Attack
items.summary: LimeSurvey before 6.17.16+260814 and 7.x before 7.0.10+260813 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the public statistics page via POST parameter names. Attackers can submit backtick-containing parameter names to buildSelects() and use blind techniques to read administrator password hashes and survey responses on MySQL or MariaDB.

items.title: CVE-2026-129854: RedAmon 4.0.0 before 7.8.0 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to control other tenants' agent sessions by supplying arbitra
items.summary: RedAmon 4.0.0 before 7.8.0 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to control other tenants' agent sessions by supplying arbitrary session ids. Attackers can call /api/agent/sessions, interact and kill routes to list, kill, or send commands into other users' meterpreter and shell sessions on their compromised targets.

items.title: CVE-2026-129855: RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting
items.summary: RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting to its WebSocket listener on port 8016. Attackers who can reach the port from co-resident containers or the host loopback can send keystrokes to an interactive /bin/bash session, executing commands as root inside the kali-sandbox container.

items.title: CVE-2026-129856: wallabag 2.3.3 before 2.6.16 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through article author metadata rendered w
items.summary: wallabag 2.3.3 before 2.6.16 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through article author metadata rendered with Twig raw in entry.html.twig. Attackers can embed HTML event handlers in a web page's author metadata so scripts run in a victim's wallabag session when the saved entry is opened, exposing their data.

items.title: CVE-2026-127044: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the STEL Order Tempo module. The server retrieves data based on the `empleadoId` parameter without checking the user's permissions. By mo
items.summary: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the STEL Order Tempo module. The server retrieves data based on the `empleadoId` parameter without checking the user's permissions. By modifying this parameter, an authenticated user can view the first name, last name, role, job title, and vacation days of other employees.

items.title: CVE-2026-127043: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the myGESTIÓN Time Tracking module. The server skips the permission check when processing the “worker” parameter. By modifying this param
items.summary: Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) in the myGESTIÓN Time Tracking module. The server skips the permission check when processing the “worker” parameter. By modifying this parameter, an authenticated user can view other users' time logs, including those of administrators.

items.title: CVE-2024-58408: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in initLookupTables() in image/decode/strdec.c caused by an u
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in initLookupTables() in image/decode/strdec.c caused by an unchecked bit depth index. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range bit depth in the image header to read beyond the cbChannels array, causing crashes or memory disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2025-5809: An improper privilege management vulnerability in an LDAP extension used with OpenText eDirectory could require a technical or proxy user to be granted write permission to the ACL
items.summary: An improper privilege management vulnerability in an LDAP extension used with OpenText eDirectory could require a technical or proxy user to be granted write permission to the ACL when only permission to modify a specific LDAP attribute is intended. A user who possesses the proxy user's credentials could use the excessive ACL permission to modify access rights for objects within the affected container, potentially resulting in unauthorized elevation of privilege. The issue is addressed in OpenText eDirectory 25.2.

items.title: CVE-2024-58407: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in DecodeSignificantRun() in image/decode/segdec.c due to an
items.summary: Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a global buffer over-read vulnerability in DecodeSignificantRun() in image/decode/segdec.c due to an unchecked run length. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XR file with an out-of-range iMaxRun value that indexes gSignificantRunBin[] out of bounds, causing memory disclosure or crashes during decoding.

items.title: CVE-2026-88019: When Apache Shiro is used with the Jakarta EE integration module, the automatic form saving feature weakens the security of a form that is resubmitted after login. Cookies set by t
items.summary: When Apache Shiro is used with the Jakarta EE integration module, the automatic form saving feature weakens the security of a form that is resubmitted after login. Cookies set by the application during the resubmission could lose their security attributes, such as `Secure` and `SameSite`. In addition, the resubmitted form data and cookies could be sent to an untrusted host. This issue affects Apache Shiro from 2.0.0-alpha through 3.0.1, only when using `shiro-jakarta-ee` integration module with form saving enabled (the default). Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.2 or later, which no longer replays the form over the network, and avoids this class of issues entirely. Alternatively, you can set the `org.apache.shiro.form-resubmit-host` (String) and `org.apache.shiro.form-resubmit-port` (Integer) system properties to restrict the host and port that Shiro will connect to when resubmitting a form.

items.title: CVE-2026-74762: Apache Shiro is vulnerable to session fixation when a user is authenticated via the "Remember me" functionality. In affected versions, when a subject is restored from a "Remember m
items.summary: Apache Shiro is vulnerable to session fixation when a user is authenticated via the "Remember me" functionality. In affected versions, when a subject is restored from a "Remember me" cookie, the existing session is not invalidated, nor is a new session created with a new ID. Additionally, session IDs were accepted from the request URL even when session ID URL rewriting was disabled. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.0, only when RememberMe functionality is enabled. Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.1 or later, which fixes the issue by invalidating the existing session and creating a new session with a new ID when a subject is restored from a "Remember me" cookie, and by ignoring session IDs in the URL when URL rewriting is disabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-74763: Authorization annotations, such as @RequiresRoles and @RequiresPermissions, are not always enforced in some class or interface hierarchies. Annotations declared on an interface wer
items.summary: Authorization annotations, such as @RequiresRoles and @RequiresPermissions, are not always enforced in some class or interface hierarchies. Annotations declared on an interface were not enforced when using the shiro-guice, shiro-aspectj, shiro-cdi or shiro-jakarta-ee modules. In addition, annotations declared on a class or a superclass were not always enforced when using shiro-guice or shiro-aspectj, allowing an unauthorized caller to invoke methods that should be protected. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.1, with impact depending on module and where annotations are declared. Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.2 or later, which fixes the issue. The annotation closest to the invoked method now takes precedence. Alternatively, declare authorization annotations directly on each protected implementing method.

items.title: CVE-2026-129348: When PropertiesRealm reloads its properties file, removed users and narrowed permissions could remain in effect. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.1, only wh
items.summary: When PropertiesRealm reloads its properties file, removed users and narrowed permissions could remain in effect. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.1, only when PropertiesRealm`loads its properties from a file, which is reloaded periodically by default. Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.2 or later, which fixes the issue. Alternatively, restart the application after removing users or narrowing permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-129690: The vulnerability enables any attacker with admin access to dump credentials of all accounts stored on the device, which can then be reused for lateral movement or further compromi
items.summary: The vulnerability enables any attacker with admin access to dump credentials of all accounts stored on the device, which can then be reused for lateral movement or further compromise. Since passwords are stored or processed in a recoverable format, this represents a critical failure in secure credential handling.

items.title: CVE-2026-129919: Kunai, a security monitoring tool, contains a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in its mount namespace (mnt ns) caching logic. When resolving a security event th
items.summary: Kunai, a security monitoring tool, contains a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in its mount namespace (mnt ns) caching logic. When resolving a security event that references a specific process PID and an expected mount namespace, the Switcher::new function read /proc/ /ns/mnt to determine the target namespace and cached the result under the expected namespace key without verifying that the resolved namespace actually matched the expected one. An attacker with local access could exploit this by either (1) arranging for the referenced PID to be reused by a process in a different namespace (e.g., the host namespace) before Kunai resolves it, or (2) calling unshare or setns on the target process after the event is generated but before the namespace is resolved. In either case, the wrong namespace (potentially the host's own namespace) would be cached under the container's namespace key. The security impact is that subsequent container security events would be resolved against host filesystem paths rather than container paths. This undermines the integrity of the security monitoring data: container activity could be misattributed to the host, host activity could be m

items.title: CVE-2026-124724: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, when a request reaches the configured limit on the number of multipa
items.summary: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, when a request reaches the configured limit on the number of multipart parts, each further part is skipped without attaching an error listener to the skipped part stream. If the request body ends in the middle of such a skipped part, the vendored Dicer parser emits an error on that stream, and because nothing is listening Node.js raises an unhandled error event and the process exits. A single crafted unauthenticated request is therefore enough to crash the server. The bug is latent in the parser on its own and was first demonstrated through @fastify/multipart versions 10.1.2 through 10.1.4, which keep feeding the request body to the parser after a limit error, and it affects any consumer that sets a finite parts limit and parses request bodies that can be terminated early. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.6, and users should upgrade to 3.2.6 or later. There is no complete application level workaround because the crash happens inside the parser before application code runs, though consumers that set a finite parts limit should also attach an error listener to the

items.title: CVE-2026-128835: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, a multipart part whose header block is never terminated before the n
items.summary: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, a multipart part whose header block is never terminated before the next boundary is counted by the vendored Dicer parser as an open part that never ends, so the parser emits neither a finish nor an error event and the request hangs. A single unauthenticated request of roughly one hundred bytes triggers the stall, and through @fastify/multipart the hung handler is not released when the client disconnects, so repeated requests leak handlers and whatever resources they hold, such as files, database connections and concurrency slots, until the process is restarted. The same parser is reached by the formData methods of undici versions 5.25.3 through 6.7.0. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.6, and users should upgrade to 3.2.6 or later. As a workaround, configure Fastify's handler timeout so hung handlers are eventually terminated and their resources released.

items.title: CVE-2026-128842: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart and url-encoded form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, the url-encoded parser stops accumulating a field on
items.summary: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart and url-encoded form data used by Fastify. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.5, the url-encoded parser stops accumulating a field only when the decoded length exactly equals the configured per-field size limit, and a malformed percent escape is passed through verbatim by the decoder, so the decoded length can jump from just below the limit to just above it and skip that equality check. The parser then keeps buffering the field in memory until the next delimiter or the end of the request, so a single unauthenticated url-encoded field or field name can grow to the size of the whole request body regardless of a much smaller configured per-field limit, with memory use bounded only by the independent whole-request body limit. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.6, which clamps a field as soon as the decoded length reaches or exceeds the limit, and users should upgrade to 3.2.6 or later. As a workaround, set a conservative whole-request body limit so the per-field overshoot cannot exceed it.

items.title: CVE-2026-128846: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 3.2.1 through 3.2.5, the parser can interpret the same multipart bytes differently depend
items.summary: @fastify/busboy is a streaming parser for multipart form data used by Fastify. In versions 3.2.1 through 3.2.5, the parser can interpret the same multipart bytes differently depending on how they are split across socket reads: when the sequence that terminates a part's header block arrives split exactly at the configured header size limit, an off by one error drops the final header line, so a part declared as a binary file attachment is emitted as an ordinary text field instead of a file. A remote client controls both the multipart body and the header padding needed to reach the boundary and can influence segmentation, so an application that applies upload validation such as malware scanning or extension checks only to file events while trusting plain field values may process the payload through the wrong path. The parser level type confusion is fully reproducible, while the downstream validation bypass depends on the application. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.6, which tracks how many terminator bytes were actually buffered when the limit is reached so a split terminator no longer corrupts the final header, and users should upgrade to 3.2.6 or later.
