items.title: CVE-2026-124758: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the record data length of an IODWrite request to a non-user record index against the size of the record block header. The 32-bit length is reduced
items.summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the record data length of an IODWrite request to a non-user record index against the size of the record block header. The 32-bit length is reduced by the header size before it is passed to the record handlers, so a length smaller than the header underflows and the handlers receive a data length of about 65530. The fixed-size reads of the I&M and PDPort handlers can then read past the end of the session buffer. The result of the write is discarded. The attacker must have an established Application Relationship or be able to send in the context of one, and requires ADJACENT network access.

items.title: CVE-2026-124759: P-Net before 1.0.4 routes a received RTA alarm frame to an Application Relationship using only the destination alarm reference in the frame, without checking the source of the fram
items.summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 routes a received RTA alarm frame to an Application Relationship using only the destination alarm reference in the frame, without checking the source of the frame. A host with ADJACENT network access can abort an established Application Relationship with a single alarm ERROR frame, or deliver forged alarm notifications with chosen type, slot, subslot, USI and payload to the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-124760: P-Net before 1.0.4 sets the alarm receiver state to waiting for confirmation before the data of a received alarm notification is parsed. If the parsing fails the state is not resto
items.summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 sets the alarm receiver state to waiting for confirmation before the data of a received alarm notification is parsed. If the parsing fails the state is not restored, and later alarm notifications of the same priority are discarded without acknowledge until the Application Relationship is released. The Application Relationship and the cyclic data exchange keep working. The attacker must be able to send an alarm notification in the context of an established Application Relationship and requires ADJACENT network access.

items.title: CVE-2026-124761: P-Net before 1.0.4 copies the IP suite of a DCP Set request to the current and the non-volatile configuration, and starts saving it, before the state of the device is checked. If t
items.summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 copies the IP suite of a DCP Set request to the current and the non-volatile configuration, and starts saving it, before the state of the device is checked. If the request is refused, for example because an Application Relationship is active, the configuration is not restored and is still saved. After a restart the device uses the refused address, and may not answer the controller or may use its address. A host with ADJACENT network access can use this while an Application Relationship is active.

items.title: CVE-2026-124762: P-Net before 1.0.4 finds the RPC session of a received PDU by its activity UUID only, and a reject, fault or cancel PDU for the session aborts the Application Relationship, without
items.summary: P-Net before 1.0.4 finds the RPC session of a received PDU by its activity UUID only, and a reject, fault or cancel PDU for the session aborts the Application Relationship, without checking that the PDU is the answer to a call of the device or where it comes from. A host with ADJACENT network access that has observed the activity UUID of the connection, which is sent in clear in every RPC request, can abort the Application Relationship with one PDU. It also allocates a session for an unknown activity UUID and changes the address stored for an existing session.

items.title: CVE-2026-120221: In FRRouting, bgpd frees the same memory twice when dynamic BGP neighbors disconnect, if the peer-group used by a "bgp listen range" also has a Site-of-Origin configured ("neighbor
items.summary: In FRRouting, bgpd frees the same memory twice when dynamic BGP neighbors disconnect, if the peer-group used by a "bgp listen range" also has a Site-of-Origin configured ("neighbor PG soo"). Each dynamic neighbor shares the peer-group's SoO value instead of getting its own copy, but frees it as its own when the neighbor is deleted, which happens as soon as its connection closes. The first disconnect leaves the peer-group pointing at freed memory, and the second disconnect frees it again, causing bgpd to abort and drop all BGP sessions on the router. Any host whose address falls inside the listen range can trigger this by opening and closing two TCP connections to the BGP port, without sending any BGP message and without knowing the AS number, and can repeat it each time bgpd restarts. If the peer-group has a TCP-MD5 password, only hosts that know the password can trigger it. Two ordinary flaps of legitimate dynamic neighbors have the same effect. Between the two frees, displaying the configuration ("show running-config") or establishing a dynamic neighbor also reads the freed memory, which can crash bgpd after a single disconnect. items.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA has added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-114713 UnrealIRCd Improper Neutralization of Delimiters Vulnerability CVE-2026-123039 Check Point Multiple Products Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise. Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirements for Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies. BOD 26-04 reinforces the importance of the KEV Catalog and requires federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities, specifically those identified by Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) listed in CISA’s KEV Catalog on publicly exposed assets that grant total control of the asset post-exploitation, while deferring action for lower-risk vulnerabilities. items.summary: This vulnerability exists in the eMudhra emBridge due to missing authorization checks in the FileBrowser API endpoints. These endpoints perform file system enumeration using the LocalSystem account without adequately validating the requesting caller's authorization. An unauthenticated attacker on the same LAN could exploit this vulnerability by sending malicious webpage to the local HTTPS Web API. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to enumerate file and directory names and obtain information about the directory structure of the targeted system. The vulnerability however, does not provide access to file contents or permit file modification, deletion, or code execution, or access to cryptographic keys and hardware token PINs.

items.summary: exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying unbounded row r attributes parsed in row-xform.js. items.title: CVE-2026-128344: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an unbounded image anchor column in the dr
items.summary: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an unbounded image anchor column in the drawing part. Attackers can set an anchor column such as 300000000 in xl/drawings/drawing1.xml so reading getImages() anchor positions makes Worksheet.getColumn allocate millions of Column objects and abort with a heap out-of-memory error.

items.title: CVE-2026-128332: Listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a 2FA bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to brute-force TOTP codes because the attempt counter resets on e
items.summary: Listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a 2FA bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to brute-force TOTP codes because the attempt counter resets on every new password login. Attackers can repeatedly submit credentials to POST /admin/login to obtain fresh tokens, each allowing 15 more guesses, gaining sessions for 2FA-protected accounts including Super Admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-128333: listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in doResetPassword that skips TOTP verification after a password reset. Attackers who can complet
items.summary: listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in doResetPassword that skips TOTP verification after a password reset. Attackers who can complete a reset, such as by reading the victim's reset email, obtain fully authenticated sessions including Super Admin without the TOTP code.

items.title: CVE-2026-128334: listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit Azure Event Grid bounce webhooks when no shared s
items.summary: listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit Azure Event Grid bounce webhooks when no shared secret is configured. Attackers can POST forged EmailDeliveryReportReceived events with Bounced status to /webhooks/service/azure to blocklist, unsubscribe, or delete arbitrary subscribers.

items.title: CVE-2026-128335: Contao 4.6.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0-RC1 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0-RC1 before 6.0.6 fails to invalidate existing user sessions when two-factor authentication is enabled or disabled. Be
items.summary: Contao 4.6.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0-RC1 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0-RC1 before 6.0.6 fails to invalidate existing user sessions when two-factor authentication is enabled or disabled. Because Contao\User::isEqualTo() and serialized session data omit two-factor state, attackers already holding a session keep it after the owner changes 2FA settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-128336: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows attackers to add numeric keys to Object.prototype through a crafted defined name referencing a __prot
items.summary: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows attackers to add numeric keys to Object.prototype through a crafted defined name referencing a __proto__ sheet. Attackers can supply an xlsx whose xl/workbook.xml definedName range targets __proto__, causing CellMatrix to write empty arrays onto Object.prototype process-wide when workbook.xlsx.load() runs.

items.title: CVE-2026-128337: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeConditionalFormattings that allows attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying an x14:cfRule id of
items.summary: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeConditionalFormattings that allows attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying an x14:cfRule id of __proto__. Attackers can craft an xlsx file that, when loaded with xlsx.load(), sets properties such as type, direction, border and cfvo on every object in the process until it restarts.

items.title: CVE-2026-128241: The xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 contains a symlink following vulnerability because -d output mode opens files with fopen("wb"), which follows symbolic links. Local attack
items.summary: The xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 contains a symlink following vulnerability because -d output mode opens files with fopen("wb"), which follows symbolic links. Local attackers with write access to the output directory can plant a symlink at the expected output name to truncate or overwrite files writable by the xmlwf user.

items.title: CVE-2026-128242: actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an unbounded decompression vulnerability in encoding::Decoder that lets remote attackers exhaust memory and CPU via com
items.summary: actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an unbounded decompression vulnerability in encoding::Decoder that lets remote attackers exhaust memory and CPU via compressed bodies. Attackers can send small highly compressed gzip, deflate, Brotli or zstd request bodies to Json, Form, Bytes or String extractors, or serve them to awc clients, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-128328: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to list tracked files of any git repository by supplying an arbi
items.summary: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to list tracked files of any git repository by supplying an arbitrary repoPath to patch.readRepoDirectories. Attackers with read access to one service can enumerate file and directory names of other tenants' application and compose source trees on the host or managed servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-128329: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to read arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the filePa
items.summary: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to read arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the filePath of patch.readRepoFile. Attackers with service read permission can read /etc/shadow, SSH private keys, and secret environment files on the Dokploy host or managed remote servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-128330: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because password changes do not revoke existing web s
items.summary: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because password changes do not revoke existing web sessions. Attackers holding a leaked password or copied session cookie keep access for up to 30 days, reading integration credentials, creating API keys, or registering passkeys.

items.title: CVE-2026-128331: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an unverified password change vulnerability that allows holders of a signed-in session to change the account password without supplying the current p
items.summary: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an unverified password change vulnerability that allows holders of a signed-in session to change the account password without supplying the current password. Attackers with a stolen session cookie or unattended device can submit new password fields via updateSettings to lock out the owner and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-128052: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the template filter's {{layout}} directive, which rend
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the template filter's {{layout}} directive, which renders arbitrary layout handles without enforcing the admin/block whitelist that the {{block}} directive applies. Administrators with rights to edit email, CMS, widget or newsletter content can embed {{layout}} with arbitrary handles to render disallowed blocks and disclose limited information.

items.title: CVE-2026-128053: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in its error pages, which print SCRIPT_NAME-derived
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in its error pages, which print SCRIPT_NAME-derived URLs built by errors/processor.php without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft links that trigger uncaught exceptions on servers deriving SCRIPT_NAME from the request path, executing script in the storefront origin within victims' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-128237: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in BER_num_dec() and BERcodec_OID.do_dec() that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying oversized OID arcs
items.summary: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in BER_num_dec() and BERcodec_OID.do_dec() that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying oversized OID arcs. Attackers can send ASN.1/BER data with many base-128 continuation bytes to cause quadratic CPU consumption or an uncaught ValueError crash on Python 3.11+.

items.title: CVE-2026-128238: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the BER/ASN.1 decoder in scapy/asn1/ber.py that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash parsing appl
items.summary: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the BER/ASN.1 decoder in scapy/asn1/ber.py that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash parsing applications. Attackers can send a single 833-byte packet with 250 nested ASN.1 SEQUENCE structures to trigger an unhandled RecursionError, terminating TLS, SNMP, X.509, or LDAP parsers even with safe=True.

items.title: CVE-2026-128239: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial-constraint handlers in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c that lets attackers crash the p
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial-constraint handlers in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c that lets attackers crash the process via unchecked group lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose Form constraints reference a non-existent group, crashing tools like MP4Box during chapter import for denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-128240: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c because gf_sg_reset() frees unregistered prototypes still reference
items.summary: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c because gf_sg_reset() frees unregistered prototypes still referenced by scene commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene declaring prototypes via commands, processed by MP4Box -chap, to trigger freed memory access and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-128044: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.x before 21.0.0-beta3 validates OAuth 1.0a oauth_callback URLs with a string-prefix check and falls back to accepting any well-formed URL
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.x before 21.0.0-beta3 validates OAuth 1.0a oauth_callback URLs with a string-prefix check and falls back to accepting any well-formed URL. Attackers holding a leaked consumer key and secret can supply host-suffix, userinfo, or arbitrary callback URLs to capture an approving administrator's or customer's request token and verifier, then obtain an access token with the victim's API privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-128045: OpenMage Magento-LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an authorization bypass in the /rss/order/status feed because its URL key is unsigned Base64-encod
items.summary: OpenMage Magento-LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an authorization bypass in the /rss/order/status feed because its URL key is unsigned Base64-encoded JSON of the order, increment, and customer ids. Unauthenticated attackers can forge keys from enumerated sequential ids to read other customers' names, items, prices, totals, and status comments when order-status RSS is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-128046: OpenMage magento-lts 20.17.0 before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability because the general/file/protected_extensions bl
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts 20.17.0 before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability because the general/file/protected_extensions blocklist omits phar, php8, and phps. Unauthenticated attackers can upload a .phar file through a product File custom option to a predictable media/custom_options path and request it directly to execute code on servers that map .phar to PHP and serve that directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-128047: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta pre-releases before 21.0.0-beta3 generate customer email-confirmation keys with md5(uniqid()) and customer and administrator pas
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta pre-releases before 21.0.0-beta3 generate customer email-confirmation keys with md5(uniqid()) and customer and administrator password-reset tokens with the non-cryptographic uniqHash(). Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force the roughly 20-bit confirmation key via the unrate-limited confirmAction endpoint to log in as pending customers, or predict administrator reset tokens after recovering generator state.

items.title: CVE-2026-128048: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 lets restricted administrators read decrypted configuration secrets because the store.getConfig email templ
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 lets restricted administrators read decrypted configuration secrets because the store.getConfig email template directive's encrypted-path check missed config.xml-declared paths, case variants of the getConfig method name, and parent paths. Administrators with Transactional Emails access can preview a crafted template to expose PayPal, payment gateway, and carrier credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-128049: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSi
items.summary: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSimple actions, which accept GET requests without form-key validation. Attackers holding OAuth consumer credentials can lure a logged-in administrator or customer to a crafted confirm URL that authorizes the attacker's request token, then exchange it at /oauth/token for a persistent REST API access token bound to the victim.

items.title: CVE-2026-128051: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because storefront MSRP/MAP popup and Qty Increments n
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because storefront MSRP/MAP popup and Qty Increments notice templates output product names without proper escaping. Attackers with admin product-edit rights can store a malicious product name that executes script when shoppers view product, category, or wishlist pages.

items.title: CVE-2026-128031: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because admin controllers' _isAllowed() checks fall back
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because admin controllers' _isAllowed() checks fall back to, or only check, parent ACL resources instead of finer per-action permissions. Authenticated restricted administrators can mass cancel or hold orders, rewrite order shipping addresses, export customer report data, or create REST roles despite their role denying those permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-128032: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 accepts the free (No Payment Information Required) payment method on orders with a non-zero total because t
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 accepts the free (No Payment Information Required) payment method on orders with a non-zero total because the zero-total check runs only when payment data is imported. An API user with cart permissions can select free via cart_payment.method while the total is zero, raise it with cart_coupon.remove, and submit cart.order to place an unpaid full-price order.

items.title: CVE-2026-128033: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Mage_Rss_Model_Resource_Order::getAllCommentCollection(
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Mage_Rss_Model_Resource_Order::getAllCommentCollection(), which omits the is_visible_on_front filter for invoice, shipment and credit-memo comments. Authenticated customers can open the /rss/order/status feed for their order to read internal staff comments, such as fraud-review and payment notes.

items.title: CVE-2026-128040: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because admin pages render Dataflow profile link varia
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because admin pages render Dataflow profile link variables, tax rate titles, OAuth consumer names, and PayPal certificate filenames without escaping. An administrator restricted to one affected area can store script that runs when another administrator, including a full administrator, opens the page, reading the form key and performing actions with that administrator's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-128041: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 serves RSS feeds with a text/html content type and does not escape feed entry data, leading to stored cross
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 serves RSS feeds with a text/html content type and does not escape feed entry data, leading to stored cross-site scripting. An unauthenticated guest can submit a product review with script in the nickname, title or text that executes when an administrator opens the pending-reviews feed, enabling admin account takeover.

items.title: CVE-2026-128042: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a race condition in shopping cart price rule usage limits, because Mage_SalesRule_Model_Validator
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a race condition in shopping cart price rule usage limits, because Mage_SalesRule_Model_Validator checks coupon limits without locking and the usage counters are later incremented non-atomically. Unauthenticated attackers, including guest shoppers, can submit concurrent checkouts to redeem a limited coupon more times than its cap allows.

items.title: CVE-2026-128043: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in PayPal cancel and decline return handlers that trust
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in PayPal cancel and decline return handlers that trust only the checkout session without verifying the request came from PayPal. Attackers can lure a shopper into a cross-site GET to paypal/standard/cancel to cancel their recent uninvoiced order, void pending authorizations, and restore items to the cart.

items.title: CVE-2026-128024: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in goArray() that allows remote attackers to abort the server process via arrays with null integer-keyed element
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in goArray() that allows remote attackers to abort the server process via arrays with null integer-keyed elements. Attackers can send crafted JSON passed to frankenphp_log() or returned from worker callbacks, triggering an unrecovered cgo panic that terminates every vhost and in-flight request.

items.title: CVE-2026-128025: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a path-split interpretation conflict in splitPos in cgi.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute protected PHP scripts by embedding .ph
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a path-split interpretation conflict in splitPos in cgi.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute protected PHP scripts by embedding .php inside a filename component. Attackers can request paths like /uploads/a.php.txt/b.php to execute uploads/a.php despite route-level or WAF deny rules and forge PATH_INFO, SCRIPT_NAME, and PHP_SELF values.

items.title: CVE-2026-128026: FrankenPHP from 1.5.0 before 1.13.0 contains an incomplete environment sandbox vulnerability in which putenv writes to the process-wide OS environment via os.Setenv, leaking values
items.summary: FrankenPHP from 1.5.0 before 1.13.0 contains an incomplete environment sandbox vulnerability in which putenv writes to the process-wide OS environment via os.Setenv, leaking values across concurrent requests. Attackers reaching a request path that spawns child processes with the default environment through proc_open or exec can read secrets such as database passwords set by other requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-128027: FrankenPHP Docker images before 1.1.11 were rebuilt only when new base image tags were created, so security fixes that Alpine, PHP, and Go applied under existing tags were not prop
items.summary: FrankenPHP Docker images before 1.1.11 were rebuilt only when new base image tags were created, so security fixes that Alpine, PHP, and Go applied under existing tags were not propagated. Remote attackers could exploit known flaws in the stale system libraries, such as CVE-2025-15467 in libcrypto3, to execute code.

items.title: CVE-2026-128028: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Mage_Catalog_Model_Product_Option_Type_File, which
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Mage_Catalog_Model_Product_Option_Type_File, which accepts guest SVG, XHTML, or XML uploads through product File custom options with an empty allowed-extension list. Unauthenticated attackers can send the file URL under media/custom_options/ to victims, executing script in the store origin and exposing administrator sessions when the admin panel shares that origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-128029: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Dataflow profile run page, which inserts catalo
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Dataflow profile run page, which inserts catalog product import row errors into the page without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can place markup in the store, type, or attribute_set columns of an import file to run script in the session of the administrator who imports it.

items.title: CVE-2026-128030: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability because Mage_Api_Model_Session::_renewBySessId()
items.summary: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability because Mage_Api_Model_Session::_renewBySessId() never checks api_user.is_active and REST OAuth authorization never checks whether the admin user is active. Attackers holding an existing SOAP/XML-RPC session or OAuth access token retain API access after deactivation or API key rotation, reading and modifying customer, order and catalog data.

items.title: CVE-2026-128018: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in worker mode where frankenphp_handle_request() returns false without finishing the dequeued request after a fa
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in worker mode where frankenphp_handle_request() returns false without finishing the dequeued request after a fatal error during request startup. Attackers who trigger startup fatal errors against worker scripts that keep calling frankenphp_handle_request() can leave client requests hanging indefinitely while the worker continues running.

items.title: CVE-2026-128019: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in worker mode that leaks per-request environment variables into later requests on the same PHP thread. At
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in worker mode that leaks per-request environment variables into later requests on the same PHP thread. Attackers can read values set via env directives with request placeholders or WithRequestEnv() through getenv() or $_SERVER, causing applications to act on another user's routing, tenant, or authorization values.

items.title: CVE-2026-128020: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in its PHP-to-Go array converter that fails to detect circular references in PHP arrays. Passing a self-re
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in its PHP-to-Go array converter that fails to detect circular references in PHP arrays. Passing a self-referential array to frankenphp_log() or returning one from a worker callback triggers a fatal Go stack overflow, terminating the entire server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-128021: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows later clients to read earlier clients' libxml errors because worker mode never resets LIBXML(e
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows later clients to read earlier clients' libxml errors because worker mode never resets LIBXML(error_list) between requests. Attackers sending requests to the same worker thread can call libxml_get_errors() or libxml_get_last_error() to obtain other clients' parsed-document fragments and server filesystem paths.

items.title: CVE-2026-128022: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to tie up PHP threads because queued requests are not cancelled when clien
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to tie up PHP threads because queued requests are not cancelled when clients disconnect. Attackers can send many requests and close connections immediately, forcing handleRequestWithRegularPHPThreads and worker handlers to execute them and delay all clients sharing the thread pool.

items.title: CVE-2026-128023: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to spoof trusted headers by sending dot-form header names that PHP re
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to spoof trusted headers by sending dot-form header names that PHP rewrites to underscores. Attackers can send headers like X.Authenticated.User or X.Forwarded.For that map to $_SERVER keys, spoofing user identity, client IP, or scheme.

items.title: CVE-2026-127093: Rustrak before 0.26.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows users with integrations update permission to send requests to arbitrary destinations by suppl
items.summary: Rustrak before 0.26.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows users with integrations update permission to send requests to arbitrary destinations by supplying routing_override.url to POST /api/integrations/{id}/test. Attackers can target loopback, private-network and cloud metadata addresses with custom headers and redirects followed, reading non-2xx response bodies returned in the API response.

items.title: CVE-2026-127094: Pagelayer 2.1.7 before 2.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Abilities API abilities registered in main/abilitiesregister.php that only require the edit_posts cap
items.summary: Pagelayer 2.1.7 before 2.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Abilities API abilities registered in main/abilitiesregister.php that only require the edit_posts capability. Contributor-level attackers can overwrite, publish, delete, or duplicate other users' private posts and pages to read them, and modify site-wide theme templates like headers and footers.

items.title: CVE-2026-128014: FrankenPHP standalone static binaries 1.8.0 before 1.13.2 bundle the PHP brotli extension statically linked with Brotli 1.2.0, whose decoder contains an out-of-bounds write (CVE-20
items.summary: FrankenPHP standalone static binaries 1.8.0 before 1.13.2 bundle the PHP brotli extension statically linked with Brotli 1.2.0, whose decoder contains an out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497). Unauthenticated remote attackers can send crafted data to applications that pass it to brotli_uncompress_add() to crash the entire FrankenPHP process, and possibly cause memory disclosure or code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-128015: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that leaves a dangling pointer to a freed environment table when putenv() is called during request shutdown. Attack
items.summary: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that leaves a dangling pointer to a freed environment table when putenv() is called during request shutdown. Attackers triggering putenv() in shutdown functions, destructors, or session handlers can crash the process on the next getenv() call or leak previous request environment values.

items.title: CVE-2026-128016: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in worker mode that frees internal streams of SplTempFileObject or SplFileObject on php://temp instances surviving

items.summary: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 lacks rate limiting on password-reset OTP verification, allowing unauthenticated attackers to brute force 6-digit OTPs. items.summary: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to link pipeline stages to environments of other projects by supplying a foreign project_env_id. items.summary: Huginn before 2026.11.09 contains an information exposure vulnerability in JqAgent that allows authenticated users to read the server process environment because the jq child process inherits it. items.summary: Huginn from 2026.09.09 before 2026.11.09 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability because OutboundProxy.configure! applies the egress proxy only to Faraday and Typhoeus. items.summary: Teable before 2026-10-12T12-45-53Z.3331 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to upload SVG or HTML attachments with an attacker-chosen content type. items.summary: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create environments on unassigned Kubernetes clusters by tampering with cluster_id and namespaces values. items.summary: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to attach another application's environment to their service by supplying a foreign project_env_id. Authenticated users can submit quote-free payloads that bypass add_escape_custom to perform blind or UNION-based injection and exfiltrate patient health information.

items.title: CVE-2026-126479: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in five Module Manager InstallerController actions that lack the admin/manage_modules ACL check and CSRF validat
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in five Module Manager InstallerController actions that lack the admin/manage_modules ACL check and CSRF validation. Low-privilege users such as Front Office accounts can POST to saveConfig or SaveHooks to overwrite any module's configuration, retarget CCDA and HIE settings, and delete module hooks.

items.title: CVE-2026-126480: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in CcrTable::insertApprovedData() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through request parameter names used as
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in CcrTable::insertApprovedData() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through request parameter names used as column names. Attackers can send crafted patient_data-*-sel parameters to the revandapprove route, lacking ACL and CSRF checks, to copy password hashes into patient fields or corrupt records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126481: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in era_payments.php and sl_eob_search.php that allows authenticated billing users to write files outside the ERA direct
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in era_payments.php and sl_eob_search.php that allows authenticated billing users to write files outside the ERA directory. Attackers can embed traversal sequences in the GS04 element of an uploaded X12 835 file to overwrite .edi or .835 files with attacker-controlled content anywhere writable by the web server.

items.title: CVE-2026-126470: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the Carecoordination module that allows authenticated users with send_to_hie permission to access
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the Carecoordination module that allows authenticated users with send_to_hie permission to access any patient's CCDA/CCR/QRDA documents. Attackers can supply arbitrary document or patient IDs to download, transmit, or export patient health records, inject falsified clinical data, and delete audit records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126471: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in print_referral.php and trend_form.php that allows low-privileged Front Office users to access patient PHI wit
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in print_referral.php and trend_form.php that allows low-privileged Front Office users to access patient PHI without patients:med permission. Attackers can directly request these endpoints with arbitrary patient_id values to retrieve patient demographics, insurance data, and vitals history, enumerating IDs to expand disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-126472: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php that allows any authenticated low-privilege staff user to retrieve other patient
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php that allows any authenticated low-privilege staff user to retrieve other patients' C-CDA documents. Attackers can request the view or dl action with sequential pid values and their own CSRF token to enumerate and exfiltrate medications, problems, allergies, and immunizations.

items.title: CVE-2026-126473: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains OAuth scope canonicalization and containment flaws that allow unauthenticated attackers to obtain unapproved system-level FHIR access. Attackers can r
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains OAuth scope canonicalization and containment flaws that allow unauthenticated attackers to obtain unapproved system-level FHIR access. Attackers can register a colon-form system:Patient.read client that bypasses approval, then request unregistered system/Patient.write scope to read, modify, and create Patient records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126474: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ACL module that allows attackers to execute JavaScript in authenticated sessions via the module_
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ACL module that allows attackers to execute JavaScript in authenticated sessions via the module_id parameter. Attackers can deliver crafted acl/index or acl/acl links that inject unencoded input into inline script blocks, stealing non-HttpOnly session cookies and modifying ACL configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-126475: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting payloads into the searchEleNo PO
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting payloads into the searchEleNo POST parameter of the application/index/search endpoint. Attackers can break out of unencoded HTML attributes in auto-suggest.phtml to inject event handlers that fire on DOM insertion, stealing non-HttpOnly session cookies and patient data.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PatientPortalPDFDocumentCreator::createPdfObject() that allows authenticated patients to make the server issue HTTP GET requests. Attackers can submit img src, inline style url(), or reinserted unpurified style blocks via the content parameter of portal/lib/doc_lib.php to probe internal ports and cloud metadata endpoints.

items.title: CVE-2026-126465: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the patient portal api/onsiteactivityviews endpoint that allows any authenticated staff user to inject SQL through u
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the patient portal api/onsiteactivityviews endpoint that allows any authenticated staff user to inject SQL through unquoted Id_BitwiseAnd Criteria values. Attackers can close the bitwise parenthesis and append OR or UNION SELECT clauses to read patient PHI, staff password hashes, MySQL authentication strings, and API tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-126466: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create patient records and enumerate patients by omitting aclCheckCore() c
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create patient records and enumerate patients by omitting aclCheckCore() checks. Attackers can POST to new_comprehensive_save.php to create patients with insurance PHI, or query new_search_popup.php and patient_select.php to leak names, SSNs and DOBs.

items.title: CVE-2026-126467: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in ObservationController::processEnhancedFormSave() that allows authenticated low-privilege users to forge authorizati
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in ObservationController::processEnhancedFormSave() that allows authenticated low-privilege users to forge authorization flags through an incomplete field blacklist. Attackers can submit authorized=1 or override the id field alongside observation_id to mark observations as Provider-signed and overwrite clinical fields of other observations within the same patient encounter.

items.title: CVE-2026-126468: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated low-privilege user to access reports, dated reminders, and batch reminder endpoint
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated low-privilege user to access reports, dated reminders, and batch reminder endpoints lacking AclMain::aclCheckCore() checks. Attackers can request patient_list.php, amc_full_report.php, dated_reminders_add.php, or batch_reminders.php directly to export patient PHI, send unauthorized reminders, and trigger batch reminder processing.

items.title: CVE-2026-126469: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in several custom/ scripts that rely only on session authentication and never call AclMain::aclCheckCore(). Any
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in several custom/ scripts that rely only on session authentication and never call AclMain::aclCheckCore(). Any authenticated low-privilege user can request export_labworks.php, chart_tracker.php, or export_registry_xml.php to disclose patient SSN, DOB, and insurance data or provider NPI/tax IDs, and forge chart-tracker records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126458: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in authorizations_full.php that allows any authenticated staff user to authorize arbitrary patients' clinical re
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in authorizations_full.php that allows any authenticated staff user to authorize arbitrary patients' clinical records. Attackers can send a mode=authorize request with an attacker-chosen pid and their own CSRF token to set authorized=1 on billing, forms, pnotes, and transactions records, bypassing provider review.

items.title: CVE-2026-126460: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a persistent SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber(), where the CLP01 claim control number from uploaded X12 835 ERA files is concaten
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a persistent SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber(), where the CLP01 claim control number from uploaded X12 835 ERA files is concatenated unescaped into a query. Attackers with billing write access can upload a crafted .edi file via sl_eob_search.php that is stored on the server and re-executes a time-based payload whenever it is reprocessed through sl_eob_process.php, extracting patient health information.

items.title: CVE-2026-126461: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/user_settings.php that lets any authenticated user persist arbitrary global configuration overri
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/user_settings.php that lets any authenticated user persist arbitrary global configuration overrides. Attackers can POST global:-prefixed keys to re-point external service hosts like CouchDB, eRx, phiMail, or SMTP to attacker-controlled servers, exfiltrating system credentials and patient PHI.

items.title: CVE-2026-126462: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Eye Exam edit permission to inject scripts via the Next Visit Orders
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Eye Exam edit permission to inject scripts via the Next Visit Orders PLAN[] field. Attackers can store a payload closing the textarea in view.php, executing JavaScript when another user opens the Eye Exam editor to steal session identifiers or clinical data.

items.title: CVE-2026-126463: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple sql injection vulnerabilities that allow authenticated users to inject payloads through ERA CLP01, form_facility, form_icd_codes, and POST ke
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple sql injection vulnerabilities that allow authenticated users to inject payloads through ERA CLP01, form_facility, form_icd_codes, and POST key names. Attackers can perform UNION, blind, and error-based injection to read users_secure password hashes and patient PHI, and overwrite patient_data fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-126452: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in diagnosis_full.php that allows authenticated users to delete or clear any billing record by ID. Attackers can
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in diagnosis_full.php that allows authenticated users to delete or clear any billing record by ID. Attackers can supply a target billing ID in the id parameter with delete or clear mode to deactivate other patients' charges and corrupt financial records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126453: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an inverted comparison in Document::has_expired() that causes the FHIR Binary download endpoint to treat time-limited PHI documents as unexpired after
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an inverted comparison in Document::has_expired() that causes the FHIR Binary download endpoint to treat time-limited PHI documents as unexpired after their one-hour lifetime. Authenticated users still authorized for a Binary/{id} resource can download expired bulk export NDJSON files and $docref CCDs indefinitely.

items.title: CVE-2026-126454: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 lacks rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission, allowing attackers with a valid password to brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Attackers can script repeated
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 lacks rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission, allowing attackers with a valid password to brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Attackers can script repeated POST requests to main_screen.php or the OAuth2 authorization flow with re-submitted hidden credentials to bypass two-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-126455: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple missing authorization and SQL injection defects across report, portal, transaction, and immunization components. Low-privileged Front Office
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple missing authorization and SQL injection defects across report, portal, transaction, and immunization components. Low-privileged Front Office clerks can chain these to read arbitrary database tables including users_secure hashes, hijack patient portal identities, and forge approved clinical records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126456: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Fee Sheet notecodes field, which is escaped with the wrong context. Attackers with clinician access
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Fee Sheet notecodes field, which is escaped with the wrong context. Attackers with clinician access can inject a payload that breaks out of the single-quoted value attribute and executes in higher-privileged users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-126457: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in InstallerController that allows any authenticated user to modify module administration settings without the a
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in InstallerController that allows any authenticated user to modify module administration settings without the admin/manage_modules permission. Low-privileged users such as Front Office clerks can POST to saveConfig, DeleteAcl, DeleteHooks and nickName actions to reconfigure or partially disable installed modules.

items.title: CVE-2026-126445: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to modify arbitrary Patient Flow Board trackers without the patients/app
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to modify arbitrary Patient Flow Board trackers without the patients/appt permission. Attackers can submit a victim tracker_id to patient_tracker_status.php or drug_screen_completed.php to falsify check-in status, rooms, drug-screen completion, and tracker history.

items.title: CVE-2026-126446: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to retrieve destroyed-drug records because destroyed_drugs_report.php la
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to retrieve destroyed-drug records because destroyed_drugs_report.php lacks the admin/drugs or inventory/reporting ACL check. Attackers can submit the report refresh form with a chosen date range to obtain drug names, NDC, lots, quantities, destruction methods, witnesses, and notes.

items.title: CVE-2026-126447: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in trusted-messages-ajax.php that allows any authenticated core user to send Direct messages without the patient
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in trusted-messages-ajax.php that allows any authenticated core user to send Direct messages without the patients/notes permission. Attackers with zero-ACL accounts can submit chosen recipients and message bodies sent via the clinic's phiMail credentials, impersonating the clinic to deliver fraudulent clinical communications.

items.title: CVE-2026-126448: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users lacking nationnotes/nn_configure to modify shared Nation Notes templates by call
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users lacking nationnotes/nn_configure to modify shared Nation Notes templates by calling mutation endpoints directly. Attackers can send requests to ajax_code.php or add_context.php, which lack ACL and CSRF checks, to tamper with clinical-note templates and assignments.

items.title: CVE-2026-126449: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in immunizations.php, diagnosis_full.php, and billing_process.php that lets low-privileged users bypass ACL chec
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in immunizations.php, diagnosis_full.php, and billing_process.php that lets low-privileged users bypass ACL checks. Authenticated Front Office users can reuse their session CSRF token to add or delete immunizations, write encounter billing codes, and invoke the billing processor.

items.title: CVE-2026-126450: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by placing payloads in the patient External ID field. Th
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by placing payloads in the patient External ID field. The payload executes when other users open the patient's prescriptions via View Printable Version (HTML), running script in their browser sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-126451: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows portal patients to run JavaScript in staff sessions by injecting javascript: URLs into documen
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows portal patients to run JavaScript in staff sessions by injecting javascript: URLs into document template_data. Attackers can submit an encounterForm value rendered unsanitized into an iframe src by DocumentTemplateRender, letting the script read PHI and CSRF tokens and call staff or admin endpoints.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization flaw in the Care Coordination CCDA and CCR import controllers, which move a document named by the document_id parameter into the import category without checking access to the source document. Authenticated non-administrators with Care Coordination access can recategorize protected patient documents and then download them through normal ACL-checked retrieval.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the CAMOS rx_print.php printer that allows authenticated users to read other patients' prescriptions. Attackers can submit forged chrx_ parameters with global prescription IDs to disclose drug names, dosages, directions, and refill counts without medication permissions.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in create_portallogin.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to replace patient portal credentials without ACL checks. Attackers can select a victim patient in session and post replacement credentials to take over portal accounts, read PHI, and lock patients out.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in dynamic_finder_ajax.php that allows authenticated users without patients/demo permission to query patient demographics. Attackers can supply arbitrary patient_data columns via the sColumns parameter to enumerate names, dates of birth, contact details, and Social Security numbers across the practice.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Ensora eRx integration that allows authenticated staff without patients/rx permission to access prescription data by directly requesting eRx.php. Attackers can expose selected patients' demographic, medication, and allergy data in the vendor XML and trigger eRx synchronization state changes.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/drugs/dispense_drug.php, which checks only for admin/drugs view permission instead of write permission before dispensing medication. Authenticated users with read-only drug administration access can send GET requests with drug_id, quantity, fee, and encounter parameters to create false dispensing records and decrement inventory.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/forms/procedure_order/common.php that allows authenticated accounts lacking patients/lab permission to read and modify other patients' procedure orders. Attackers can request a global order id to disclose clinical history, or select the target patient in their session and submit bn_save to falsify diagnoses, instructions, and order status.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/order_manifest.php, which checks patients/med without requiring write access or applying patient squad restrictions. Users with only patients/med view permission can request any order ID to read squad-restricted patient data and submit bn_save and form_omit parameters, without a CSRF token, to set do_not_send flags that suppress ordered lab procedures.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth2 clients to use unregistered grant types because oauth_clients.grant_types is never enforced. Attackers can request tokens with grant_type=password to bypass the user consent screen, and disabled clients can redeem authorization codes using JWT client assertions.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in portal/lib/download_template.php that allows any authenticated core user to render documents for arbitrary patients by setting isModule. Attackers can submit arbitrary pid and template_id values to disclose patient names, birth dates, chart IDs, addresses, allergies, medications, and problem lists despite ACL and squad restrictions.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/patient_file/rules/patient_data.php that allows read-only patients/med users to modify clinical-rule records. Attackers can submit a global form_entryID row ID to overwrite completion date, state, and result, including records of patients outside their configured squad.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php that fails to enforce the patients/pat_rep permission, accepting any authenticated core session. Authenticated users without patient-report permission can request the report_ccd_view action to retrieve the selected patient's C-CDA clinical summary, including diagnoses, medications, laboratory results, and identifiers.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a session expiration vulnerability that prevents automatic logoff because the Eye Exam form's read-only poll omits skip_timeout_reset. Attackers with physical access to an unattended workstation can use the still-active session to view patient health information, since update_READONLY() resets the idle timer every 15 seconds.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated billing users to store attacker-controlled PHP by uploading a malformed ERA file to era_payments.php. Attackers with a database-write primitive such as SQL injection can register a background_services row whose require_once loads the stored .edi file, executing PHP as the web-server user.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 passes authenticated user-controlled HTML from the doc_lib.php content parameter to mPDF, which resolves local files and nested SVG resources. Authenticated patients or core users can submit crafted CSS imports or php://filter SVG references to read arbitrary server files including credentials and OAuth keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-126430: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandap
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandapprove controller. Attackers can embed scalar subqueries in the UPDATE patient_data SET clause to read staff password hashes and portal reset values, alter arbitrary patient demographics, and take over patient-portal accounts.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Carecoordination users to store malicious C-CDA field identifiers through the savedata action. Attackers can inject SQL into the IN clause built by fetchFormValues() during C-CDA generation to extract password hashes, portal reset values, and patient records.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/list_reports.php that allows read-only users to transmit lab orders because the patients/med check ignores write permission. Authenticated attackers can submit form_xmit with arbitrary procedure order IDs to send HL7 orders containing SSNs, insurance, and diagnoses to laboratories and mark them transmitted.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users with patients/med access to exhaust PHP workers via an unbounded count parameter. Attackers can send print_labels requests to labs_ajax.php with huge counts, forcing mPDF page and barcode generation that makes OpenEMR unavailable.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/lists_touch.php that allows restricted authenticated users to mark another patient's clinical lists as reviewed. Attackers can submit arbitrary patient_id and type values to falsely record "None known" allergy, medication, or problem lists, misleading clinicians and skewing quality-measure calculations.

items.title: CVE-2026-126423: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in four ZIP upload paths that read uncompressed entries into memory without size or ratio checks. Authenticated bill
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in four ZIP upload paths that read uncompressed entries into memory without size or ratio checks. Authenticated billing or Carecoordination users can upload highly compressed ZIP archives to exhaust PHP memory and worker pools, making OpenEMR unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-126424: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with admin/superbill write permission to inject HTML into SNOMED code descriptions via s
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with admin/superbill write permission to inject HTML into SNOMED code descriptions via superbill_custom_full.php. When a clinician selects the malicious code, the Functional and Cognitive Status form or fee-sheet forms assign it to innerHTML, executing JavaScript in the clinician's session to read patient data and perform actions.

items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in which History layout field identifiers saved through edit_layout.php, including HIS fields and LBF source-H fields, are placed unvalidated into an INSERT statement for patients without a history_data row. Users with admin/super and patients/med write access can trigger history_save.php or LBF saves to execute SQL functions like SLEEP, tying up database workers or accessing data beyond their privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-126426: OpenEMR 5.0.2 before 8.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in mfa_registrations.php and mfa_u2f.php that allows session hijackers to delete MFA factors or register
items.summary: OpenEMR 5.0.2 before 8.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in mfa_registrations.php and mfa_u2f.php that allows session hijackers to delete MFA factors or register U2F keys without password re-entry. Attackers holding a victim's authenticated session can remove all second factors or add their own U2F key, bypassing MFA at later logins with the password.

items.title: CVE-2026-126416: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker entries by supplying arbitrary tracker_id values. Attackers can post statustype and roomnum parameters with a valid CSRF token to alter patient-flow status, room assignments, and linked calendar appointment state.

items.title: CVE-2026-126417: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an access control flaw in get_claim_file.php: with location=tmp, it serves any file in the shared temporary directory without verifying the file is a
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an access control flaw in get_claim_file.php: with location=tmp, it serves any file in the shared temporary directory without verifying the file is a claim for the caller. Users with acct/eob or acct/bill write access can request key=ccda.xml to download the most recently validated patient's complete C-CDA clinical document.

items.title: CVE-2026-126418: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php, which escapes billing codes for HTML attributes but not for JavaS
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php, which escapes billing codes for HTML attributes but not for JavaScript strings in an inline onkeyup handler. Clinicians with encounter coding access can save crafted billing codes through diagnosis.php that execute script when a Back Office user enters a payment, exposing patient and financial data or performing actions as that user.

items.title: CVE-2026-126419: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password,
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password, not access to the patient, encounter, or form type. Authenticated core users can supply arbitrary formId, formDir, and encounterId values to sign and lock any patient's clinical form, creating unauthorized approval records and blocking normal editing.

items.title: CVE-2026-126420: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's utility.php that allows read-only demographics users to create patient charts. Attackers
items.summary: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's utility.php that allows read-only demographics users to create patient charts. Attackers can submit the form_create request with chosen identity fields to create fictitious or duplicate patients with employer, history, and insurance records.

items.title: CVE-2026-126409: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype d
items.summary: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype does not validate that the supplied supertype belongs to the same Engine. Embedders using multiple engines that create a GC struct type with another engine's supertype can trigger runtime panics or GC heap corruption, causing denial of service; guest WebAssembly cannot trigger it.

items.title: CVE-2026-126410: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket
items.summary: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket host implementation that lets guests bypass socket_addr_check send restrictions. A malicious guest can race udp-socket.send against udp-socket.connect to deliver attacker-controlled datagrams to addresses the policy permits only for receiving.
